title: Aromatic Dense Italian Beef Calamarata
description: A peppery, dense, and romantic Italian dish featuring shredded meat and al-dente calamarata, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: calamarata pasta
ingredients.notes: preferably made from durum wheat semolina

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the calamarata pasta according to the package instructions until al-dente.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the shredded beef brisket and cook until browned, breaking it up into smaller pieces as it cooks.
Add the tomato paste, rehydrated porcini mushrooms, and red wine, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced and the sauce has thickened.
Season the sauce with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Drain the cooked calamarata pasta and add it to the sauce, tossing to combine.
Serve the calamarata hot, garnished with additional black pepper if desired.
